notes:
• Arrange the desktop app's tabs and panes by dragging, from a pane's menu or with ⌥⇧⌘ keys; resuming the session brings the layout back.
• In the desktop app, ⌘-click a URL in Main or any ZTC pane to open it, even one wrapped over several rows outside code blocks and tables.
• If ZTC crashes or hangs, the desktop app keeps your panes running, and a banner can end a hung ZTC without closing them.
• Very long sessions and huge messages no longer freeze or crash ZTC, and those sessions resume; a 128K-character paste is now a badge too.
changes: A session holding one huge message resumes, and long sessions keep Main updating.
The desktop app, zmux and ztc-tui keep up when a window or a terminal stops reading, and say what they dropped.
Panes no longer inherit the terminal that started ZTC.
Moving panes in the desktop app never leaves a workspace that won't save.
The desktop app keeps your panes when ZTC crashes, and offers to end a ZTC that hangs.
⌘-click a URL in Main, or any ZTC pane, to open it.
ZTC saves the desktop app's arrangement as soon as it changes.
A paste of 128K characters or more is a badge in the composer, even on one line.
zmux's mirror takes 16 viewers and lets an idle one go after two minutes.
